purpose: Homepage creative direction for one continuous scroll-controlled Tasso film, plus an original-label review variant.
scope: Replace the existing Tasso process presentation within EvaFilm's product scene. Preserve the runner, the other homepage chapters, brand type, palette and navigation.

sourcePlan.continuation: The existing 17-second packaging-to-results film requested by the user.
sourcePlan.continuousVisualRule: One film surface and one monotonic source-frame sequence. Do not dissolve between separate photographs, replace the results shot with a screenshot, or add a second playback clock.

brand.kicker: THREE EASY STEPS / TRES PASOS SENCILLOS
brand.heading: One small step. / Un pequeño gesto.
brand.visual: Warm paper and ink around a deliberate 16:9 cinema window. Restrained Hanken text and the established italic serif emphasis.
brand.composition: A persistent common heading, one sharp active step, and a quiet three-part index. The genuine physical film supplies the motion; copy supplies the meaning.

steps.intent: Give the upper-arm collection enough scroll travel to register before the camera reaches the return materials.
Follow the protected sample into its return envelope. Explain prepaid shipping with copy; invent no markings on the filmed package.
Let the front-facing dashboard register, then continue the native orbit into the reader's quiet understanding and smile.

proposedTiming.captionTransition: A short opacity/8px settle affects only the copy. Avoid two simultaneously legible paragraphs. Film frames remain continuous and fully opaque.
proposedTiming.scrollTravelRecommendation: Give the settled product segment approximately 3 viewport heights of native scroll travel, with the other authored chapters retaining their existing choreography. A piecewise scroll-to-author-frame mapping requires the same inverse mapping for chapter jumps.
proposedTiming.timingStatus: Creative recommendation; the motion engineer may adjust exact easing and hold lengths after testing actual media and responsive layouts.

variants.clean: Customer-facing editorial composition: copy beside the film on desktop and below it on phone. No labels are burned into the source video.
variants.labelled: Same source frames, scroll mapping and factual copy. Add original animation labels in a safe HTML caption rail or letterbox area; keep the device, hands, face and dashboard unobstructed.
variants.labelSource: components/story/TassoProcess.tsx is the first homepage animation's caption source. remotion/tasso-film-first/TassoFilmFirst.tsx explicitly renders a text-free edit and supplies no burned labels.
variants.reviewPlacement: The clean/labelled comparison control belongs on the review route or review query, not as a technical selector in the main customer journey.

responsiveAndAccessible.phone: Keep the entire 16:9 frame contained above copy. Do not crop to a portrait viewport: collection and tablet occupy different edges. Reduce media height before reducing essential text or hiding the timing qualifier.
responsiveAndAccessible.shortPhone: Use a compact common heading and sensible spacing. Preserve readable body copy and a clear area above the existing chapter controls.
responsiveAndAccessible.reducedMotion: Show the three steps as a readable ordered sequence with actual film stills. Include the full preparation paragraph, kit instructions, return protection, prepaid shipping and laboratory-receipt timing.
responsiveAndAccessible.reverse: Reverse scrolling traverses the same source frames. Keep the last complete canvas frame during cache misses; never reset to the first poster on reverse entry.
responsiveAndAccessible.semantics: Use one semantic ordered transcript outside any aria-hidden film/canvas. Original-label overlays are decorative duplicates of the same readable step content.

factualCopyRules: Display '2 working days' and 'From laboratory receipt of your sample.' together whenever timing appears.
State protected sample and prepaid return; do not suggest mailing the used collection device, an uncapped tube or loose blood.
Keep full warm/clean/dry preparation and press-once-and-release wording in the shared long transcript/reduced-motion path.
Do not imply instant full collection or results arriving immediately after sealing the envelope.
Public example-data wording can be discreet. Asset encoding, native small-text limitations and source geometry warnings belong in review notes rather than the customer flow.
inheritedMediaLimitations: The native dashboard's main layout and 29/EVA 82 are recognizable; small labels/date/ring are approximate.
The retained native film contains paper-prop construction changes during the camera orbit. Scroll integration does not claim to correct those source-image defects.
reviewGates: Collection, protected prepaid return and understanding are clear at stable stopped positions.
Forward and reverse input drive one continuous film surface without blank frames, photo dissolves or an independent autoplay clock.
Timing always includes laboratory receipt, including narrow phone and reduced-motion layouts.
Original-label variant uses exact retained labels without covering product, hands, face or dashboard.
A loading or decoding failure preserves readable content and the last complete frame.
The entire product segment enters/exits with the existing authored scene rather than becoming a disconnected second carousel.
